name: Sample: parts of a cell
notes:
Parts of a cell
The cell membrane controls what enters and leaves the cell.
Mitochondria turn food into energy (ATP): they're the powerhouse of the cell.
The Golgi apparatus packages proteins and ships them where they're needed.
Lysosomes break down waste and worn-out parts with digestive enzymes.
The nucleus is the control center of the cell: it holds the DNA.
Chloroplasts use sunlight to make food for plant cells (photosynthesis).
Plant cells have a stiff cell wall for support and protection.
The vacuole stores water and nutrients; plant cells have one big one.
Ribosomes build proteins.
The smooth ER makes lipids (fats) and breaks down toxins.

stops.label: glass doors
stops.fact: The cell membrane controls what enters and leaves the cell.
stops.scene: The glass doors are a MEMBERS-ONLY bouncer: they slide open for water and snacks, then slam shut on a pizza that's way too big.
stops.hook: cell membrane → members-only doors · controls what enters and leaves → the bouncer
stops.imagePrompt: Glass sliding doors with a grumpy bouncer face and a velvet rope, letting a water bottle and a cookie walk in while slamming shut on a giant pizza

stops.label: rocking chairs
stops.fact: Mitochondria turn food into energy (ATP): they're the powerhouse of the cell.
stops.scene: MIGHTY grandpas munch sandwiches and rock so hard the rocking chairs turn into a POWERHOUSE, popping out glowing ATP batteries.
stops.hook: mitochondria → mighty rocking grandpas · food into energy → sandwiches in, batteries out
stops.imagePrompt: Two muscular grandpas eating sandwiches while rocking wildly in white rocking chairs, glowing batteries popping out of the chairs with lightning sparks

stops.label: shop window
stops.fact: The Golgi apparatus packages proteins and ships them where they're needed.
stops.scene: Behind the shop window, a clerk in GOLF gear gift-wraps protein bars, slaps on address labels and ships the boxes out the door.
stops.hook: Golgi apparatus → the golfer clerk · packages and ships proteins → gift-wrapped boxes going out
stops.imagePrompt: A cheerful shop clerk in golf clothes and a golf cap behind a shop window, gift-wrapping boxes and tossing them onto a moving delivery cart

stops.label: recycling bins
stops.fact: Lysosomes break down waste and worn-out parts with digestive enzymes.
stops.scene: The recycling bins are full of LYSOL-like digestive juice: toss in old trash and broken parts, and they fizz away to nothing.
stops.hook: lysosomes → Lysol bins · digestive enzymes → the fizzing juice · waste and worn-out parts → old trash
stops.imagePrompt: Two blue recycling bins full of bubbling green fizzing liquid, a banana peel and a broken gear dissolving into bubbles as they fall in

stops.label: big screen
stops.fact: The nucleus is the control center of the cell: it holds the DNA.
stops.scene: BREAKING NEWS on the big screen: "NEW CLUES!" The anchor reads orders off a twisting DNA ladder, and the whole atrium does what it says.
stops.hook: nucleus → "new clues" news · DNA → the twisted-ladder script · control center → everyone obeys the screen
stops.imagePrompt: A giant screen showing a bossy news anchor reading from a twisting DNA ladder, little people and chairs in front of it saluting

stops.label: orange chairs
stops.fact: Chloroplasts use sunlight to make food for plant cells (photosynthesis).
stops.scene: The orange chairs become loungers by a CHLORINE pool. Green leaves sunbathe in them, soaking up sunlight and cooking sugar snacks.
stops.hook: chloroplasts → chlorine-pool loungers · photosynthesis → leaves turning sunlight into food
stops.imagePrompt: Green leaf characters in sunglasses lounging in orange lounge chairs beside a blue pool, sunbeams shining on them as they cook sugar cubes on a tiny grill

stops.label: gator statue
stops.fact: Plant cells have a stiff cell wall for support and protection.
stops.scene: A potted PLANT hides inside the gator statue's stiff, armored scales. You knock on them: hard as a WALL. Only plants get armor like this.
stops.hook: cell wall → the gator's stiff armor · plant cells → the potted plant inside
stops.imagePrompt: A smiling potted plant peeking out from inside a stiff armored alligator statue, a fist knocking on the hard scales

stops.label: janitor cart
stops.fact: The vacuole stores water and nutrients; plant cells have one big one.
stops.scene: The janitor cart's bucket is a giant VACUUM-sealed tank of water and snacks. In a plant it's so big it fills the whole cart.
stops.hook: vacuole → vacuum-sealed tank · stores water and nutrients → water and snacks · one big one in plants
stops.imagePrompt: A janitor cart with a huge sealed water tank bulging out of it, sloshing water and snacks inside, a small plant sitting proudly on top

stops.label: bookshelf
stops.scene: Tiny builders in RIBBONS pull a recipe off the bookshelf, read it, and snap blocks into one long chain: a PROTEIN bar they hand to you.
stops.hook: ribosomes → builders in ribbons · build proteins → a chain of blocks becomes a protein bar
stops.imagePrompt: Tiny builders wearing ribbons pulling a recipe book off a bookshelf and snapping colorful blocks into a long chain shaped like a protein bar

stops.label: staircase
stops.fact: The smooth ER makes lipids (fats) and breaks down toxins.
stops.scene: The banister is SMOOTH and slick with BUTTER. You slide all the way down, and at the bottom a mop scrubs away a puddle of green poison.
stops.hook: smooth ER → the buttery smooth banister · lipids → butter (fats) · breaks down toxins → mopping up poison
stops.imagePrompt: A kid sliding down a shiny buttered staircase banister, a mop at the bottom scrubbing away a bubbling green poison puddle
